name: autoscaling-scaling-demo-sustained
description: IO-T009 scaling demonstration: a constant-rate open-loop-poisson load at 50 rps (~1.5x the single-replica capacity this same admission-sane-v1 config measured in the signal-comparison run, phase 3 -- see experiments/autoscaling/report.md), held for 60s and run TWICE with the SAME seed: once against 1 gateway replica ('before'), once against 2 replicas behind haproxy ('after' -- compose-scaling, not HPA pod rescheduling, per RQ-14; see docs/implementation-notes.md). Same request-size distributions as the signal-comparison workload for direct comparability.
